newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemex upgraded to "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemex upgraded to "buy".

text.p: -- Valores Finamex said it was upgrading Mexican cement firm Cemex SA to "buy" from "hold"
-- Analyst Gerardo Copca said in a report that a construction revival in Mexico in 1997 should make Cemex an outperformer in 1997

-- He said Cemex, "the most efficient and technologically advanced cement producer in the world" after cost cuts and efficiency improvements at newly-acquired operations, had restructured its liabilities to the extent that the average term of Cemex debt had increased to 4.5 years from 2.9 years
-- Cemex had underperformed the Mexican Bolsa and lagged behind its main competitors since 1995
-- a pick-up in the Mexican domestic market should mean Mexican operations would comprise 50 percent of operating cash flow in 1997
-- He predicted the company's share price could rise as high as 48 pesos per share in 1997
